question: Do the Column 79 side plates prevent Floor 13 girder A2001 from walking off, and what do the available UAF model records and construction drawings establish?
scope: Public-source, read-only local/source audit and reproducible conditional geometry calculation; preserve all earlier evidence and uncertainties
admitted_sources: Both hash-pinned March 2020 UAF report PDFs
Existing public native-case locator and Column 79 drawing crosswalk, as prior research rather than primary model proof
Current official UAF project and staff pages for dataset/contact attribution
Public copies of technical Frankel sheets 1091 and 9114, if ordinary bounded acquisition succeeds
Official NIST technical reports and their responses/errata for the competing account
native_file_check: Inventory tracked public Git paths and selected currently available UAF access-audit records. Record scope, hashes and absent operational inputs. Do not reopen previously rejected aggregate-archive routes or equate a routing wrapper with native inputs. No whole-disk absence claim.
new_acquisition_limit: One ordinary HTTPS GET per exact newly identified drawing URL, no credentials/cookies, 16MiB cap each, 60-second total with short socket waits. Create-only files in the verified Intel operational store. A web-reader fetch error is not an access denial; actual HTTP denial stops the route. No aggregate UAF model or drawing-package download.
drawing_checks: Preserve entire original retrieved PDFs, inspect complete sheets including identifiers/revision blocks, distinguish mirror custody from authenticated agency release/as-built condition, and distinguish original dimension annotations from later redrawn figures.
conditional_calculation: Use separately labeled report dimensions to compute idealized rigid in-plane lateral first-contact and loss-of-web-bearing distances. Test axial engagement, vertical engagement, rotation, deformation, connections and contact/failure assumptions as required conditions, not presumed facts. No solver run or load-bearing capacity assertion from geometry alone.
acceptance: Publish exact source observations, calculation code and tests, comparison with available construction depictions, native-file availability limits, claim ledger, and smallest specific records needed to decide the unresolved capacity/history question. Verify every new public commit identity and remote publication as AveLyra.
exclusions: No private case material or correspondence in public output
No model execution without identified inputs/runtime and separate documented protocol
No historical cause or intent inferred from illustration or access gaps
No third-party contact or email transmission
